content.short: TransferGo is a digital remittance service for fast, low-cost transfers across migrant corridors in Europe.
content.description: TransferGo is a digital remittance and money-transfer service focused on migrant corridors, helping people send money home quickly and affordably across Europe, the UK and increasingly other regions. Users send funds to bank accounts, cards and wallets in many countries, often with same-day or near-instant delivery and transparent, low fees, while holding balances and managing transfers from the app. Built around the needs of migrant workers and their families, TransferGo emphasizes speed, reliability and clear pricing for the routes its customers use most. With millions of users, it competes with other digital transfer providers by offering fast delivery and competitive exchange rates on popular remittance corridors.
